IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR PwBD CATEGORY CANDIDATES 
 
This Notice is issued to the above Notification for CRP PO/MT –XVI dated 01.07.2026 for the 
purpose of clarification.  
 
Vide Clause B (II I) of the said Notification it ha s been stated that “the post is identified 
suitable for the Persons with undernoted categories of disabilities as defined in the 
Schedule of RPWD Act 2016 and notified by the Department of Empowerment of Persons 
with Disabilities (Divyangjan) from time to time”. 
 
In view of the above, vide Gazette Notification No. 38-16/2020-DD-III dated 04.01.2021 and 
Office Memorandum No. 41-01/2024-DD-III (CN: 37325) dated 08.11.2024 issued by the 
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Department of Empowerment of persons with 
Disabilities (Divyanjan), Government of India, a list of posts suitable for persons with 
Disabilities along with the Functional Requirements is provided.  
 
Accordingly, the identified disa bilities and functional requirements for the post of 
Probationary Officers/ Management Trainees eligible for the process is as under:
